common.privacyStrip: Your data never leaves your browser — verify it yourself in the Network tab.

home.lede: Drop a dataset, pick what to predict, and train a set of models on your own machine. No account, no upload, no setup — and every run is scored against an honest baseline.

ml.title: ML Lab
ml.description: Train and compare classification and regression models on tabular data, with metrics, plots and plain-language explanations.

data.title: Data
data.description: Data pipelines and engineering tools — profiling, transformations, quality checks.

ai.title: AI
ai.description: Deep learning and generative modules — vision, chat over your data.

home.statusBody: Foundations are live: design system, dual theme, French/English, routing and CI/CD. The training engine lands next.

ml.titlePre: From a CSV to a leaderboard,
ml.titleHighlight: without your data leaving the tab.
ml.lede: The lab reads your file locally, works out the task, trains a set of models and holds back part of the data to test them honestly.

upload.title: Drop a dataset
upload.description: Drag in a CSV — it is read right here in the browser, nothing is sent anywhere.

target.title: Pick a target
target.description: Choose the column to predict; the lab suggests which columns to keep.

train.title: Train models
train.description: One click. Several models are trained in parallel workers, with live progress.

read.title: Read the results
read.description: Leaderboard, metrics against a naive baseline, plots, top features and a plain read.

lab.title: new run
lab.dropHint: or click to browse — the file is read right here in your browser, nothing is uploaded
lab.errorBody: The file looks empty or not tabular. Try a CSV with a header row.

unsupported.type: This column cannot be a target — pick a numeric or categorical column.
unsupported.tooManyClasses: Too many distinct classes for a target — pick a column with at most 20.

lab.leakAlert: Target leakage: {{columns}} almost perfectly mirrors the target — excluded automatically.
lab.trainConfig: seed {{seed}} · split {{split}} · trained in your browser
lab.reproducibleNote: Same data, same seed, same results — every run is reproducible by construction.

roadmap.title: Where the build stands
roadmap.sprint1: Data engine: upload, profiling, target — shipped

data.title: Data pipelines, coming later.
data.lede: This section will host data engineering tools: profiling, transformations and quality checks — built with the same privacy-first rules as the ML Lab.

ai.title: Deep learning modules, coming later.
ai.lede: Planned here: an image classification playground running on ONNX Runtime Web, and a chat over your data with explicit consent for anything that leaves the browser.
